questions.question: Verify the historical names of the Chișinău and Tiraspol pedagogical institutes and their departments in 1940–1963; confirm the English rendering Gersh Isaakovich Gleizer.

questions.question: For each of the three published book covers in the collage, identify the specific edition, publisher and a confirmed basis for reproduction; distinguish authorship of the collage assembly from rights in the third-party images it contains.

localizations.source: For each of the three published book covers in the collage, identify the specific edition, publisher and a confirmed basis for reproduction; distinguish authorship of the collage assembly from rights in the third-party images it contains.
localizations.ru: Для каждой из трёх издательских обложек в коллаже указать конкретное издание, издателя и подтверждённое основание воспроизведения; авторство составления коллажа отделить от прав на входящие в него сторонние изображения.
